note: Bundled offline catalogue for the education view (#228 workstream B, #235). Mirrors the core registry (core/education.py + core/valuation_levels.json) so the education view renders with no backend: the dated reference and the equity-valuation rows. The band per row is derived the same way the server does (multiple versus its own long-run reference), never typed in. Synthetic demo content; do not scrape.

reference.source: OwnView education reference v0.1, drafted 24 Sep 2026. General information about asset classes, not advice.
